description: Generate a Code Engine-compatible Dockerfile for an app folder that lacks one. Auto-detects app type (static HTML/nginx, Node.js, Python) from the folder contents, or accepts an explicit app_type. Uses EXPOSE 8080 and a non-root-friendly base. Returns the generated content; writes it only when write=true.

context_path.description: Path to the app folder to scaffold a Dockerfile for

write.description: Write the Dockerfile to context_path/Dockerfile (default: false — preview only)

name: scaffold_dockerfile
